purpose: R3-A03: retrospective dry/wet stratification of saved same-day predictions
scope: all 13 main S5 models, seven domains, 2019-2025, plus saved persistence/monthly references
rainfall_source: authenticated regional rain_mm_issue in the completed CMORPH preflight cache

external_definition_sources.title: BMKG Prakiraan Musim Hujan 2023/2024 di Kalimantan Tengah
external_definition_sources.locators: printed pp.2-3, PDF pages8-9: seasonal types/period criterion; printed p.6, PDF page12: dasarian/onset definitions
external_definition_sources.supporting_facts: Defines calendar dasarians as days1-10,11-20,21-month end. Dry/wet onset uses the 50 mm threshold and persistence in following dasarians. Seasonal-period definition also allows a three-block total below/at least150 mm with the first block below/at least50 mm.

external_definition_sources.title: BBMKG Region III: Daftar Istilah Klimatologi
external_definition_sources.locators: paragraphs Zona Musim, Dasarian, Permulaan Musim Kemarau/Hujan
external_definition_sources.supporting_facts: Seasonal zones need not coincide with administrative areas. Defines calendar dasarians and the 50 mm onset threshold.

external_definition_sources.title: BMKG: Hujan di Musim Kemarau, 10 July 2024
external_definition_sources.locators: paragraph beginning Dwikorita menjelaskan, meski berstatus musim kemarau
external_definition_sources.supporting_facts: Describes less than50 mm per dasarian for at least three consecutive dasarians. Timing and duration vary by area. Rain may still occur within a dry season.

external_definition_sources.title: Aldrian and Susanto (2003), Identification of three dominant rainfall regions within Indonesia and their relationship to sea surface temperature
external_definition_sources.supporting_facts: Identifies distinct Indonesian rainfall regimes; its climatic regions are not the study rectangles.

primary_rule: strict BMKG-inspired variant: dry onset when three consecutive calendar-dasarian totals are each <50 mm; wet onset when each is >=50 mm
sensitivity_rule: mixed-block variant from the published seasonal-period criterion: first block <50 mm and three-block total <150 mm for dry; first block >=50 mm and three-block total >=150 mm for wet
state_extension: start at first qualifying dasarian; carry state until qualifying opposite onset; no change for isolated contrary blocks; accept opposite onset only after at least three blocks since previous onset to avoid overlapping confirmation windows
dasarian_definition: calendar days1-10,11-20,21-end of month; actual accumulated mm, no normalization for variable final-block length
context_period: 2001-01-01 through2025-12-31; no state reset at year or evaluation boundaries
unclassified_rule: before first confirmed onset and final two source dasarians; final two excluded because forward confirmation is unavailable
independence_boundary: external numerical rule; labels never use hotspot counts, model predictions or rankings; rainfall is the same study input, not an independent rainfall product
spatial_boundary: adapted to domain-area mean rainfall on retained study support, not official BMKG ZOM/station observations or a dry-area fraction; source/land-mask caveats remain
timing_boundary: retrospective onset confirmation uses future rainfall; strata are never predictors, model-selection criteria or operational season forecasts
main_high_threshold: retain each domain through2014 training-derived hotspot q90 threshold; do not re-estimate by season
inference: conditional descriptive performance; no causal dry/wet effect; no refits, recalibration, seed pruning or model selection
